p. 94a) prabhuṃ sarvasya deveśa niśśeṣaṃ vada me prabho
naiva tat kathitaṃ bhadre guroḥ śukrasya vānyapi
tadvacchiva manāmeyaṃ dṛśyate na ca dṛśyate
tile tailaṃ drume cchāyā sauṣupte kulamadhyagam
cintayā rahitaṃ cittaṃ niścittaṃ paramaṃ padam
p. 96b) gṛhyānandodbhave cakre klinnā saṃpīḍanena tu
tatrādhikaṃ tu parato yatra sṛṣṭirna jāyate
p. 97a) na pramāṇaṃ prameyaśca na guṇo doṣa eva ca
na varṇaṃ varṇajātīnāṃ na geyaṃ vedanādinām
na yakṣo na ca nāgendraṃ dharmādharmavivarjitam
na bījaṃ vanavṛkṣaṃ vā auṣadhaṃ na ca vidyate
tasya sṛṣṭiḥ sthitā cānte yo jānāti sa tatvavit
tata evāgataṃ piṇḍaṃ tatraiva ca sa gacchati
p. 98a) līyate tatra vai sthāne punastatra samāgamam
ādau tu hyakhilaṃ sarvaṃ paścāt sṛṣṭiḥ pravartate
p. 98b) yadā hyekatra tritayaṃ nityato yo pi bhāvayet
na ca lipyati pāpena karmaṇā manasāgirāṃ
sarvaṃ śivātmakaṃ viśvaṃ yā kriyā sā śivātmikā
aśuddhā nityamucchuṣmā saṅkīrṇo yaḥ sa bhairavaḥ
ete malā hyadhobhāge ūrdhvaṃ nityaṃ pradīpakaḥ
śukraṃ śleṣmaṃ śirolomā ye cānye cāṅga santatau
vyāne tu ca?krakī devī nāge tu bhujagī parā
nābhi cakre sthitāścānyāḥ koṭyo dvāsaptatiḥ kramāt
sarvāvasthaṃ śivaṃ jñātvā kona mucyeta bandhanāt?
antardeha gataṃ cittaṃ cañcalaṃ capalaṃ tathā
yadi bandhātmakaṃ viśvaṃ tadā mokṣaṃ prapadyate
baddhosau svavikalpena na ca bandhaṃ śivasya hi
bandhaṃ caiva na tasyāsti vibhutvāt sarvataḥ śivaḥ
satyākāraṃ ca deveśi na baddho na ca mucyate
p. 101b) pūrvaiva kathitaṃ sarvaṃ sarvaṃ sarvagataṃ śivam
sarvaṃ śivamayaṃ bhadre paunaḥ puṇyena kīrtitam
sadāśiva mayecchā ca na kriyā parataḥ śivaḥ
yena yena hi mārgeṇa yā dṛśe tādṛśena vā
ekākī paramo devaḥ śaktyā saha tu krīḍati
tena rūpaṃ svayaṃ dṛṣṭamarūpaṃ darśayet tathā
eko devo na cānyosti kiṃ vā dvandvena kāraṇam
advaitaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ dvaitaṃ nāsti mahāprabho
phalaṃ bījaṃ tathā snehaṃ paśyanti tilasaṃmatam
evaṃ puryaṣṭake devi śivaṃ māyā vinaṃvibhum
ācāreṇa tu kiṃ kāryaṃ ke pāśāḥ kaḥ paśuḥ smṛtaḥ
śāntendha na śikhāṃ yadvat pradīptastatra līyate
p. 104a) vṛddhakāle tu bālatvaṃ piṇḍasthosya na dṛśyate
sarvaṃ vyomārṇave līnaṃ na kiñcidapi cintayet
vyomābhāsaṃ tvayā coktaṃ sthānoddeśena kiṃ ca vā
mucyamānaṃ tu taṃ sthānaṃ na yuktiriti niścayam
naṣṭe dagdhātmake dehe kasya piṇḍaṃ padaṃ kramam
pralīne śūnyamārgeṇa kuto dānaṃ kutaḥ kriyā
krodhaṃ kālāgni rudraṃ vai mohaṃ māyā tathā priye
aṭanaṃ tu rathaṃ divyaṃ niṣṭhānta kālabhairavam
*? rmecchā ca śivecchā ca kriyecchā tritayaḥ ume
vaktre vaktrena sā dṛśyaṃ pituḥ putrasya bhāmini
vṛkṣaṃ vakṣena sādṛśyaṃ toyaṃ toye tathaiva ca
ramate jṛmbhate devo modate vadate kriyām
na ca kṛcchrāti kṛcchreṇa na ca cāndrāyaṇena vā
yaṃ yaṃ bhogāvṛtaṃ cittaṃ taṃ taṃ manasi dāpayet
tasya tasya na cotpatti kharūpī sarvato mukhaḥ
iti śrī ra * sye * de * *? si pa sa rṇa caturtha uddeśaḥ
sā * *? hṛdi me grāhyaṃ hyagrāhyaṃ paśu bhārataḥ?
p. 108b) kasyecchā trividhe kāle dṛśyate ca hyanekadhā
tasya bhedaṃ kathaṃ deva dṛśyate bhuvana trayaṃ
nagrahaṃ nigrahaṃ krū?raṃ bhaktirvā śāṭhyameva vā
nirbhrāntaṃ yena vā jñātaṃ tena jñātaṃ tu bhairavam
tatra yāti idaṃ viśvaṃ yatkiñcit pāñcabhautikam
p. 110b) sarvaṃ sarvamayaṃ cāhaṃ tatra madhye tvayāmaha
yadā palīyate dvābhyāṃ viśvaṃ na saha bhāmini
na kiñciccintanāddevi na naśyati na muhyati
nopalabdhirna caivāsti nā bhāva na? vikalpanā
kevalaṃ śūnyatā nādaṃ dvitīyo nāsti niścayaḥ
guruśiṣya krameṇātha kiṃ kāryaṃ kiṃ prayojanam
sa vikalpasya jantośca jatrasya samalasya ca
p. 111b) bhāvametā dṛśaṃ kṛtvā yā dṛśaṃ kathitaṃ tava
p. 112a) anyathā hyopadeśaṃ tu bhrānti yuktāstathānyathā
dhātu dārumayaṃ liṅgaṃ pāṣāṇorthaṃ tu hemajam
na cātra kurute trāṇaṃ caitanyasya acetanam
p. 112b) advaitabhāvaṃ deveśi trāṇārthaṃ sarvato bhavet
yadyapi syān mahādvaitaṃ dvaitaṃ vande kulāraṇī
kecit prāṇaṃ tathā buddhiḥ keciddhairaṇyameva ca
ūrṇātantu nibhaṃ kecit kecit khadyotameva ca
na tasya nāmagotraṃ ca na jātirjanma eva ca
yā dṛśaṃ bhavate vastu tādṛśena bhavet saha
labdhajñānena tajjñeyaṃ yo vindati sa paṇḍitaḥ
